headword: {伝統芸能|でんとうげいのう}

definitions.explanation: Performing art forms that have been passed down through generations in Japan, including kabuki, noh, bunraku, and traditional dance. Composed of 伝統 (tradition) + 芸能 (performing arts).

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{伝統芸能|でんとうげいのう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鑑賞|かんしょう}→鑑賞：14516_kanshou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I watched a traditional Japanese performing art.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歌舞伎|かぶき}→歌舞伎：04455_kabuki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧{伝統芸能|でんとうげいのう}だ。
examples.english: Kabuki is a representative traditional performing art of Japan.

examples.japanese: {伝統芸能|でんとうげいのう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後継者|こうけいしゃ}→後継者：12592_koukeisha⟧{不足|ぶそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧な⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧になっている。
examples.english: The shortage of successors for traditional performing arts has become a serious problem.

notes:
USAGE:
{伝統芸能|でんとうげいのう} encompasses a wide range of Japanese performing arts with long histories. Major forms include ⟦{能|のう}→能：01927_nou⟧ (noh), ⟦{歌舞伎|かぶき}→歌舞伎：04455_kabuki⟧ (kabuki), ⟦{文楽|ぶんらく}→文楽：13156_bunraku⟧ (bunraku puppet theater), ⟦{狂言|きょうげん}→狂言：04456_kyougen⟧ (kyogen comedy), and ⟦{日本舞踊|にほんぶよう}→日本舞踊：28381_nihonbuyou⟧ (Japanese classical dance).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {伝統芸能|でんとうげいのう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鑑賞|かんしょう}→鑑賞：14516_kanshou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to watch traditional performing arts)
- {伝統芸能|でんとうげいのう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{継承|けいしょう}する→継承する：17346_keishousuru⟧ (to inherit/carry on traditional arts)
